result.function: Plays a role in signal transduction by regulating the intracellular concentration of cyclic nucleotides. This phosphodiesterase catalyzes the specific hydrolysis of cGMP to 5'-GMP (PubMed:15489334, PubMed:9714779). Specifically regulates nitric-oxide-generated cGMP (PubMed:15489334)

verification.notes: 표적 실재·기능 확인. cGMP 분해효소, PDE5 저해→cGMP↑→혈관확장.
